title: Assembly-sensitive Lean verification campaign for Tate degree-sixteen cohomology in genus at most seven
exact_theorem: For every stable pair (g,n) with g at most 7, the degree-sixteen rational cohomology of the complex Deligne-Mumford stack Mbar_{g,n} of stable genus-g curves with n ordered markings is a finite direct sum of Q(-8), with rank zero allowed. Equivalently H^{16}(Mbar_{g,n};Q) is isomorphic to Q(-8)^{oplus b_{g,n}} as a polarizable rational Hodge structure. No Betti-number formula, algebraic or tautological generation, integral statement, or coarse-moduli statement is asserted.
lean_target_contract: The exported theorem must quantify over every StablePairIndex p satisfying 3 <= 2*g+n and g <= 7, and conclude the whole-group compact cohomology predicate at stable compactified complex DM stack geometry, rational coefficients, ordered markings, cohomological degree 16, weight 16 and Tate index -8. Rank is finite but unspecified and may be zero. The open term is explicitly the lowest-weight piece W_{-16} H_16^BM, not the whole Borel-Moore group. Selected examples, an open or coarse space, an image, quotient, associated graded, semisimplification, algebraic-generation claim, or differently indexed group does not satisfy this contract.

obligations.statement: Represent exactly five critical endpoint records for genera three through seven whose arithmetic is mechanically checked against the critical line 2g+n=18. Route (3,12), (5,8), (6,6), and (7,4) through the one-marking primitive-quotient argument and only (4,10) through the direct published Canning-Larson-Payne range. For (5,8), mechanically expose primitive degree 16>15, pointed degree 24>23, the exact marking endpoint 7=c(5), and psi-source codimension 11>=5. The CLP Table 1 bound c(g) must be independent of n-1 and load-bearing. Ionel-Looijenga must be one general premise carrying genus, markings, codimension, and cohomological level. Reject at-vcd vanishing, Chow-level Ionel, and every repaired-genus-five or M_{5,8} CKgP premise. The model must refute the compact target at (6,6) when the critical-line route is deleted.

Represent the complete open Borel-Moore result for every stable pair with 3<=g<=7, including a distinct vanishing predicate in the stronger zero range 2g+n>=11 whose Ionel threshold arithmetic is exposed, and the remaining published-range Tate cases. The model must refute a covered compact target when the below-critical-line route is deleted and separately when the published-range route is deleted.
Represent the genus 0,1,2 degree-sixteen base cases, odd compact vanishing through degree nine, and even compact Tate type through degree fourteen as separate audited inputs.
Type one-edge boundary factors separately from their parent and prove that every factor is stable and does not increase genus.

Represent the boundary Kunneth assembly and the finite graph-automorphism invariants as premises distinct from the low-degree compact inputs they consume, and pass from the normalized boundary source to its homological image through a distinct image carrier.

Represent the degree-preserving, untwisted right-exact boundary sequence with distinct boundary-image, compact-homology, and lowest-weight open-BM carriers and the correct kernel/quotient orientation; the model must separate right exactness from the kernel premise.

Represent smooth-proper purity as an input distinct from the purity tag it licenses, same-weight semisimplicity, and proper same-degree H_16/H^16 duality with Q(8) dual to Q(-8), never the open dimension-dependent Poincare twist; the model must make purity independently load-bearing by exhibiting a sequence that satisfies every other extension premise and whose Tate conclusion fails.

Carry out genuine well-founded strong induction on the complexity 3g+n for every stable pair with g<=7, with a strictly decreasing complexity premise at every one-edge factor; no finite list of examples and no same-complexity recursive premise is acceptable.

Represent the Bergstrom-Faber-Payne vanishing above the critical line as a premise on the whole open Borel-Moore group, with the exact n>=2 and 2g+n>18 gates, and use a distinct bridge from whole-group vanishing to vanishing of the lowest-weight carrier. The critical-line, below-critical-line, and published-range routes may not consume this premise. The model must refute the compact target at (7,8) when the BFP route is deleted.
